name: pagination
title: Pagination
description: Navigates multi-page datasets with ellipsis collapsing, first/previous/next/last controls, and router-friendly links.

files.content:
import './pagination.css'

export {
  createPaginationController,
  Pagination,
  PaginationEllipsis,
  PaginationFirst,
  PaginationItem,
  PaginationLast,
  PaginationLink,
  PaginationList,
  PaginationNext,
  PaginationPrevious,
  paginationRange,
} from '@ui-sdk/svelte/pagination'
export type {
  PaginationChangeOptions,
  PaginationController,
  PaginationLinkState,
  PaginationOptions,
  PaginationPageChangeReason,
  PaginationPrimitive,
  PaginationRangeItem,
  PaginationRangeOptions,
  PaginationState,
  PaginationStepState,
  UiPaginationLinkOptions,
} from '@ui-sdk/svelte/pagination'

export type PaginationSize = 'small' | 'normal' | 'large'
export type PaginationShape = 'square' | 'pill'
export type PaginationVariant = 'neutral' | 'contrast'
